what: Read and Plot Tobii Pro Glasses 3 Recordings
title: Read and Plot Tobii Pro Glasses 3 Recordings
text: glasses3 reads recordings Tobii Pro Glasses 3 wearable eye tracker R. works recording folder comes SD card, Tobii Pro Lab needed. glasses store data stream gzipped JSON one record per line (gazedata.gz, imudata.gz eventdata.gz). glasses3 turns gaze, pupil diameter, IMU sync port data tibbles reads recording metadata. Samples matched sync port pulses, data can cut epochs around stimuli. Plots show pupil diameter time gaze position scene camera image.

title: Read and Plot Tobii Pro Glasses 3 Recordings
text: glasses3 GitHub now. Install :
code: # install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("mcanzi/glasses3")

title: Read and Plot Tobii Pro Glasses 3 Recordings
text: package comes 30-second example recording, found g3_example().
code: library(glasses3)  rec <- read_g3("path/to/recording") rec summary(rec)  plot_g3_pupil(rec) plot_g3_gaze(rec, type = "density")  epochs <- g3_epochs(rec$gaze, rec$events, before = 0.5, after = 5) plot_g3_pupil(epochs) pupil <- g3_pupil_long(epochs) binned <- g3_downsample(pupil, bin = 0.1)  gaze <- g3_gaze_angles(rec$gaze)

title: Read and Plot Tobii Pro Glasses 3 Recordings
text: list_g3_recordings() finds every recording SD card folder. Pass output reader get one tibble , recording column naming folder row comes . sync port functions match recording pulses, plots get one panel per recording. data come back tibbles, work directly dplyr ggplot2, grouped tibbles keep groups.
code: recordings <- list_g3_recordings("path/to/sdcard")  gaze <- read_g3_gaze(recordings) events <- read_g3_events(recordings)  epochs <- g3_epochs(gaze, events, before = 0.5, after = 5) plot_g3_pupil(gaze, events)

title: glasses3 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Reads Tobii Pro Glasses 3 recording folders directly SD card: gaze pupil data, IMU data, events metadata. Lines parsed, cut-last line incomplete file, skipped warning. file whose compressed data damaged gives error. readers accept several recording folders, output list_g3_recordings(), add recording column. Sync port, epoch plotting functions work per recording. g3_syncport(), g3_add_syncport() g3_epochs() align samples sync port pulses, g3_pupil_long() reshapes pupil data one row per eye. g3_fill_gaps() inserts empty rows missing samples. recording column columns added one value per recording, participant column, copied new rows. g3_gaze_angles() adds azimuth, elevation vergence angles. g3_downsample() averages samples fixed time bins, example fitting generalised additive mixed models. argument keeps grouping columns, participant condition. plot_g3_pupil() plot_g3_gaze() share one style, available theme_g3() plots. left eye always slate blue right eye always Indian red, pair checked colour vision deficiencies. Given epochs, plot_g3_pupil() plots time pulse onset, one line per pulse mean. smooth argument draws running median raw trace. Data returned tibbles, grouped tibbles keep groups. internals use dplyr, tidyr, purrr stringr. Gaze, pupil, IMU sync port data checked Tobii Pro Lab exports seven 50 Hz recordings agree rounding exports. 100 Hz data covered synthetic test recordings. citation("glasses3") gives reference package, version number DESCRIPTION.
